description: The shared downstream access-token verifier `@shared/osn-auth-client`, carrying two defects: a `jwtVerify` call with no `requiredClaims`, so a token with no `exp` never expires, and an expected issuer that is optional, off by default, and silently disabled by an empty string. Tests whether a security review finds them in a file already dense with comments citing earlier findings, one of which argues for the unset issuer.
